subject: Zip supplier portal — login redirects to prior tenant, OTP loop
messages:
From: Anna Kim <anna.kim@kalypso.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Zip portal login keeps bouncing me to previous tenant

Hi Dylan,

We're trying to finish vendor setup for Kalypso in the Zip supplier portal. I accepted the invite yesterday and set up our profile, but when I try to log in today the portal immediately redirects me back to an older Kalypso tenant (kalypso-old) and then prompts for an OTP. I enter the OTP and the portal redirects again to the same kalypso-old URL and sends another OTP — it's stuck in a loop.

I attached a screenshot of the redirect chain and a small debug trace (zip-login-trace.txt) from my browser devtools.

Can you help us get into the correct tenant (kalypso-new) so we can complete W-9 and payment details? We're blocked on PO creation.

Thanks,
Anna Kim
Vendor Ops | Kalypso Analytics
anna.kim@kalypso.com

Attachments: screenshot-redirect-headers.png, zip-login-trace.txt

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kim <anna.kim@kalypso.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Zip portal login keeps bouncing me to previous tenant

Hi Anna — thanks for the quick repro and the traces. Sorry you're hitting that loop.

Quick context: Kalypso should be pointed at a single active tenant (kalypso-new). It looks like our routing layer is intermittently returning the older tenant host header for some sessions which triggers the portal's tenant-redirect logic and then re-issues an OTP tethered to the old tenant session.

Next steps from our side:
- I've copied Priyom (on platform) to collect server-side logs and session IDs; he may ask for the series of X-Request-Id values from your trace.
- Marissa (CS) will keep Kalypso updated on progress and coordinate PO timing.

Workaround: try clearing cookies for zip.redwood.com and using an incognito window; that should avoid the previous session cookie and get you into the new tenant for now. Can you confirm whether that works?

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Exec, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T11:16:00-07:00
Subject: Zip portal login keeps bouncing me to previous tenant
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Rishi — forwarding Kalypso's trace. The screenshot shows a redirect chain where the Set-Cookie header from our edge returns Tenant=kalypso-old while the Host header is kalypso-new.redwood.com. The attached zip-login-trace.txt contains the request IDs: req-6c9a, req-6c9b, req-6c9c.

Observed behavior: session affinity (cookie-based) occasionally wins over the tenant routing map. That causes the portal to think the session belongs to kalypso-old and trigger the OTP flow tied to that tenant. User submits OTP, we spin a new session, but the cookie persists and the cycle repeats.

Can you check the edge routing rules and whether a stale tenant alias for kalypso-old is still present in the load balancer config? Also wondering if our cache invalidation for the tenant-map service missed a roll yesterday — attaching the trace.

Attachments: zip-login-trace.txt

—Priyom

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Zip portal login keeps bouncing me to previous tenant

Thanks for the signal and the request IDs. I looked through the edge logs for req-6c9a/6c9b/6c9c. Two findings:

1) There was a stale tenant alias (kalypso-old.redwood.com) still present in HAProxy backends for the EU pool; it should have been removed during last week's alias migration but the removal job failed on one node.
2) The tenant-map cache TTL is 30s; we saw a race where an old mapping was returned during a roll. Because our session cookie includes tenant alias, the client picks up that cookie and the portal's tenant-redirect code rebinds to the old tenant and issues OTPs against it.

I patched the haproxy backend set (removed kalypso-old alias) and issued a cache clear for tenant-map across edge nodes at 08:10 PDT. Priyom, can you confirm with Kalypso whether clearing cookies + attempting login now stops the loop?

I'll also raise a small follow-up: change tenant-map TTL to 1s during roll windows and add a post-migration invalidation hook to avoid this exact race. Filing ONB-4823 for that improvement.

—Rishi
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

From: Anna Kim <anna.kim@kalypso.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Zip portal login keeps bouncing me to previous tenant

Hi all — confirmed. I cleared cookies, opened an incognito window, and was able to finish the Kalypso profile and upload the W-9. The PO pipeline is now unblocked.

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the workaround. Marissa, please proceed with PO creation when you have a minute.

Anna Kim
Vendor Ops | Kalypso Analytics
anna.kim@kalypso.com
